params.body:
## What

The six page names in the footer (Trends to Contact) sat on a line height of 1.35 with no gap and read cramped next to the sectors, which have a gap under every line.

Now `leading-[1.25]` with `gap-y-2.5`: a line every 34 px instead of 26. One class list in `partials/footer.blade.php`.
params.title: The footer's page names get room between the lines
